entry.title: Go html/template iframe srcdoc XSS
entry.summary: I reported an issue in Go html/template where interpolating untrusted input into iframe srcdoc can still lead to XSS. The short version is that html/template applies normal HTML attribute escaping, but srcdoc is special. The browser first entity-decodes the attribute value and then parses the decoded string again as a full HTML document. That means a single escaping pass is not enough for this...
